entries.title: Psalms 4:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David.>> Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved me in [my] distress; Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 4:2
segments: How long, O you sons of men, [Will you turn] my glory to shame? [How long] will you love worthlessness [And] seek falsehood? Selah

entries.title: Psalms 4:3
segments: But know that the LORD has set apart for Himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to Him.

entries.title: Psalms 4:4
segments: Be angry, and do not sin. Meditate within your heart on your bed, and be still. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 4:5
segments: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And put your trust in the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 4:6
segments: ¶[There are] many who say, "Who will show us [any] good?" LORD, lift up the light of Your countenance upon us.

entries.title: Psalms 4:7
segments: You have put gladness in my heart, More than in the season that their grain and wine increased.

entries.title: Psalms 4:8
segments: I will both lie down in peace, and sleep; For You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
